name: Theodore Roosevelt McKeldin
notable_stories: Barbara's hero, he was a powerful public speaker who famously nominated Dwight D. Eisenhower for President at the 1952 Republican National Convention
Testified before the United States Congress in opposition to capital punishment
Was appointed by President Johnson to a panel of American Advisors to oversee South Vietnam's elections
Nominated Eisenhower at the 1952 RNC; declined Ike's VP offer (Nixon got the nod instead)
Wife Aunt Honolulu was Honolulu Claire Manzer
Nominated Eisenhower at 1952 RNC; declined Ike's VP offer (becoming Nixon).
53rd Governor of Maryland (1951-59), Mayor of Baltimore (1943-47, 1963-67).
Children: son Theodore Jr. and daughter Clara.
Great uncle Teddy gave young Barbara 'A Child's Book of Bible Stories', one of her favourite books, loved for its colourful pictures.
milestones: Served as a two-term Mayor of Baltimore

career: Barbara credits him with some of the best state highways in the country, the urban renewal of Baltimore's Inner Harbor, a new municipal building and slum clearance in Baltimore.
